issues.where: data/public/calls/erc-stg-2027/call.md, opening: “Submit the narrative in English.”
issues.problem: English-only submission is not the official ERC language rule: WP2026 §1.4.1 permits every official EU language, strongly recommending English and requiring an English abstract when another language is used. The opening explicitly labels dates and the frozen eligibility window as fictional but does not label the English-only restriction. The skeleton acknowledges its invented nature only in hidden author_notes.
issues.fix: Replace that sentence with “For this fictional call, the narrative must be in English; this is a benchmark restriction. The official ERC permits other official EU languages with an English abstract.” Retain language: en.
